thread:
Ana Sato: Hey design — need a compact snackable pack for the March webinar (next Wed). Deliverables: 9 social tiles (feed + story sizes), 1 hero GIF, 1 two-up one-pager PDF, simplified benchmark diagram, and a single-slide usage note. Mobile-first, brand-safe, accessible. Deadline: Tue EOD. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/snack-webinar

Matt Chen: Copy and sizes? Will scope motion effort.

Ana Sato: CTA: "See inference wins →". Priority tiles: 1) Inference economics headline, 2) latency vs cost sparkline, 3) dedicated vs hosted quick comparison, 4) metric cheat-sheet, 5-9 product variant frames. One-pager: two-up A4, print + web optimized.

Rachel Gomez: Channels: LI org, X, IG feed + stories, webinar slide. Include alt-text templates, localization frames EN/ES/FR, and UTM guidance for launch. Add short release note template.

Matt Chen: Specs (add to figma notes):
```
ig_feed: 1080x1080
ig_story: 1080x1920
linkedin: 1200x627
x_card: 1200x675
gif: 800x800 max 2MB loop-once
pdf: A4 two-up 300dpi export web+print
colors: #0A66FF primary, #0F1720 neutral. AA contrast required.
fonts: Inter headings >=16px body >=14px
alt_text_template: "Graphic: {short-caption} — shows {metric} vs {metric} for {audience}."
```

DesignBot: Task CREATED: DESIGN-1472 "Webinar snack kit + hero GIF + one-pager" — assignee @Matt, due 2026-03-31 15:00 PST. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/snack-webinar

Matt Chen: Plan: 2 designers (visual + motion) + QA. First pass Mon 11:30, iterate Mon afternoon, final export Tue 15:00 PST. Will deliver: Figma components + tokens, 3 alt-text options per asset, localization frames for EN/ES/FR, and a CSV mapping filenames→UTM.

Ana Sato: Please run brand-check after first pass and tag @legal-design if any claim language is risky. Include a one-slide usage guide (copy + placement notes) for GTM.

Jin Park: Bench numbers for diagram (drive/bench-results): p50 45ms, p95 210ms, cost/token $0.0007 (quantized config), throughput 120 tok/s/GPU. Raw CSV: https://drive.internal/bench/2026-03-results.csv

Matt Chen: Accessibility notes: ensure alt-text filled, captions on GIFs with text overlays, keyboard focus order notes for carousels.

Rachel Gomez: Routing for final assets: drop zips in /marketing/assets/webinar-2026-03 and post release note with UTMs. One-pager should include link to tracking sheet.

Jin Park: I have translations at /i18n/webinar/2026/en_es_fr_cta.csv — DMing copies to @Matt.

DesignBot: Reminder created: DESIGN-1472 review Mon 11:30 PST on #design-review. Calendar invite sent.

Ana Sato: High priority. Ping me when first pass is up in Figma for brand-check. :thumbsup:

Matt Chen: Will ping here. Expect final exports Tue 15:00 PST. Thanks!
